$299,900, 4 bed, 2.00 bath, 2,088 SF, MLS# 607819

Wonderful, well maintained, 2088sq ft, four-bedroom home now available in Copperas Cove at Skyline Flats! Do you like the country atmosphere yet close enough to town? If so, this is the home for you! NO HOA on a mostly flat property! This single-story home has a 2-car garage with extra storage space for lawn equipment and built in Rubbermaid storage racks on the side and leads into your mud room with washer and dryer. This is a split carpeted bedroom floor plan with the main on your garage side to hear any of the kids trying to leave with a car and the other 3 bedrooms located on the opposite side. This home is equipped with a complete security system that can convey, additional components can be added to the system if desired, so you will still know if your kids are trying to sneak out. The remaining areas are tiled with the living room open to both the kitchen and formal dining room. Additional inside features include a breakfast area in the large kitchen space, granite countertops located in the kitchen and matching in both the full guest bathroom with double sinks and the main bathroom with split sinks. The main bathroom also sports a sizeable walk in closet, extra storage closet, large tub and a separate large extremely unique showering space. The backyard has a nice, covered patio that is extended by a paver-based patio with flower beds. Spend plenty of time entertaining friends, family or set up a bouncy house for a birthday party. Enhance the entertaining or personal time in the backyard with the Bluetooth outside speaker system or grill up some food after utilizing the prep station. There are so many possibilities with this home. Come see this home today and you will want to end your search to make it YOUR home now!

2 full bath
